saved.description: Written to this browser and kept.

matchTerms.title: Match terms
matchTerms.description: Research areas and phrasings the scout looks for. Separate from the keywords you file records under.

roleTags.title: Role tags
roleTags.description: The kinds of role you are tracking. Every application is filed under one, and the role filter and the per-role figures in Statistics both read it. Removing one here leaves the applications that carry it exactly where they are.

documents.title: Documents

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.description: Drop your CV and statements here, or choose them — they are filed in the Vault under {{bucket}}, where the rest of the app can reach them.

documents.footer: The same files as the Vault's <anchor>Files tool</anchor>, filtered to {{bucket}}. Drop a document here or choose one and the file itself is kept in this browser — it is not uploaded, and its text goes to a model only if you choose a hosted provider. Click one to read it.

background.title: Your background
background.hint_one: {{count}} recorded · what a posting is weighed against
background.hint_other: {{count}} recorded · what a posting is weighed against

form.title: Title
form.detailPlaceholder: Anything worth weighing a posting against (optional)
form.highlightsHint: One per line — what was built, shipped, taught or found.
form.readKept: read from a document — your edit is kept over the reading

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.configured: Put your CV, a research or teaching statement in the Vault and jojo will offer to read it — what it finds is shown to you before anything is saved. Or add an entry by hand.
empty.unconfigured: Reading a document needs a model. Connect one in Settings, then put your CV or a statement in the Vault and jojo will offer to read it. You can add entries by hand without one.

readMenu.needsModel: Reading a document needs a model. Connect one in Settings.
readMenu.nothing: Nothing in the Vault can be read yet. Drop your CV or a statement in and it appears here.
readMenu.allRead: Everything readable in the Vault has been read.

toast.weigh: jojo can now weigh a posting against what you have done.
